part.text:
Done. The project is set up:

- `index.js` — `toRegexRange(min, max, options)` library (no runtime deps), supporting `shorthand`, `capture`, `wrap`, and zero-padding options.
- `bin/cli.js` — script accepting `1-100` or `1 100`, prints the regex.
- `test.js` — 17 tests (`npm test`), verified byte-for-byte against `to-regex-range@5.0.1` across ranges `-30..120` and all option combos.

Example:
```
$ node bin/cli.js 1-100
(?:[1-9]|[1-9][0-9]|100)
```
